Dialogue.Text: Yet it remains quite simple.^1 You can still ask questions and see insights.^1 Though the insights,^2 you needn't present.
Instead,^2 you can mark statements as odd.^1 There may be multiple.
If you mark a statement as odd,^2 your text box will change and you answer the question what is asks there.
Sending it locks in the result.^1 You can always cancel the marking,^2 or unmark a statement,^2 though.
If you think you're done,^2 end your examination.
